title: Czytanie – dwa teksty powiązane tematycznie
intro: Przeczytaj oba teksty i odpowiedz na pytania.
passage:
**Text 1 – Alex**

I've been using an e-reader for five years, and I wouldn't go back. It is light, I can carry hundreds of books on holiday, and I can read in the dark. People say they love the smell of paper, but I'd rather have the convenience. What matters to me is the story, not the object.

**Text 2 – Maya**

I understand why people like e-readers, but I can't give up paper books. When I read on a screen, I get tired and find it hard to concentrate. Paper books also make wonderful gifts, and my shelves tell the story of my life. Besides, nothing is more relaxing than turning a real page.

items.prompt: What does Alex say about his e-reader?
options: It lets him read anywhere, even in the dark.
It smells like a paper book.
items.explanation: Alex: light, many books, reading in the dark.

items.prompt: Why does Maya prefer paper books?
items.explanation: Maya: tired and harder to concentrate on a screen.

items.prompt: What do both writers agree on?
What is the main difference between their opinions?
options: Alex values convenience, Maya values the physical experience.

items.prompt: What does Maya say about her bookshelves?
options: They are a gift from Alex.
items.explanation: My shelves tell the story of my life.

items.prompt: Which statement is true for Alex?
options: He prefers the story to the form of the book.
He misses the smell of paper.
items.explanation: What matters is the story, not the object.
